sections.heading: About Us
sections.content:
Alumni networks can be a great way to stay connected with institute after graduation. They are valuable resources for networking, job opportunities, and career advice. An alumni network is a great resource if students are looking for a job. Many alums are willing to help recent graduates with their job search, and they can provide advice and contacts to help you get your foot in the door.
Your network is your net worth. Porter Gale With this mindful thought Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering and Research has established an
ALUMNI ASSOCIATION OF APCOER
With Registration Number: Maharashtra/1146/2018/Pune Date: 21/08/2018 ALUMNI ASSOCIATION OF APCOER believes that associations will provide valuable resources and networking opportunities which can help alumni to stay connected with their industry and connect with other alumni.
